subject: peace-conflict-studies
intro: Peace and conflict studies leads to work that lowers the temperature: mediators settling disputes before they harden, managers running community programmes, researchers of group violence, and the fundraisers who finance peacebuilding.

roles.title: Arbitrators, Mediators, and Conciliators
roles.what: Facilitate negotiation and settle disputes outside court: hear both sides, manage communication between parties, and guide or impose agreements in labour, community, commercial and legal conflicts.
roles.where: The negotiation and mediation topic in the peacebuilding methods unit is the direct craft of this job, and the causes-of-war unit trains the analysis of interests behind every dispute you help resolve.

roles.title: Social and Community Service Managers
roles.what: Plan, direct and coordinate social service programmes and community outreach organisations: manage staff and budgets, build partnerships, and evaluate how well programmes serve their communities.
roles.where: The structural violence unit — poverty and its social drivers — shapes which programmes matter, and the measuring peace topic becomes the evaluation discipline you bring to community work.

roles.title: Sociologists
roles.what: Study social life, group behaviour and institutions: design research, collect and analyse data on conflict, inequality and change, and publish findings that explain how societies hold together and break apart.
roles.where: The course's analytic spine — negative and positive peace, direct, structural and cultural violence, the causes of war at individual, group and state levels — is a sociological lens you would formalise with graduate methods.

roles.title: Fundraisers
roles.what: Raise money for organisations: identify donors and grant sources, write proposals, run campaigns, and maintain the relationships that keep nonprofits and NGOs funded.
roles.where: NGOs and peace organisations run on the skills in the justice and reconciliation and peacebuilding units — you translate their mission into the case for support donors respond to.
